Definition: to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running)
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Hiphil) to beat (the air), flap (the wings); 1a) meaning dubious; 2) (Qal) filthy
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
